title: --worktree path:<folder> of another repository makes that repository the target
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories
intent: No --repo is needed: the selector already names the repository the worker goes into, so its skills resolve there and the event records it.

files..jitso/briefs/brief.md:
## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Look at `src/sync.ts` and `docs/guide.md` and nothing outside the repo. Do not change any file.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
